alt_texts: Two wild Asiatic lionesses resting together in the dry forest of Gir National Park, Gujarat, one staring at the camera, headline '891 wild lions. One corner of India.'
Young wild Asiatic lion eating a crow on leaf litter in Gir National Park, with text on the lion's former range from Syria to Bihar
Wild Asiatic lioness standing in open dry scrub in Gir National Park, with the statistic 891 lions counted in May 2025, up from 284 in 1990
Wild Asiatic lion cub standing among bare branches in Gir National Park and Wildlife Sanctuary, Sasan, with text on lions spreading across Saurashtra and returning to Barda
Wild Asiatic lioness looking up in the forest of Gir National Park, with text on its IUCN Red List status: lion species Vulnerable, Asiatic subpopulation Endangered
Wild Asiatic lions drinking at a waterhole in Gir National Park, closing slide with sources and photo credits
